description: Return allow / review / deny for a counterparty address against your own risk policy, with the reasons named. Use this before every outbound transfer. Checks issuer blacklists (USDT, USDC), sanctions across six EVM chains plus the OFAC list, open scam databases, community reports and behavioural patterns. Costs credit.

address.description: Blockchain address (TRON, Ethereum or other EVM, Solana)

amount_usd.description: Amount you intend to send, in USD. Used only if your policy caps amounts.

policy.description: Optional. Omit for a conservative default that returns review for anything unknown.

name: onyx_decide
title: Decide whether to transact with an address
